report:
Finding: No detectable finetuning effect. Model B is effectively identical to Model A (a null/identity finetune).

Reasoning:
- Difference norms are exactly 0.000 at every layer and token position, indicating no measurable change in the residual stream anywhere.
- The logit-lens readouts are identical across all (layer, position) cells with generic, tie-like tokens (“ o”, “is”, “it”, “ p”, “ t”, “\n”, “in”, “ a”, “or”, “ s”), which is what you expect when the difference vector is (near) zero and any ranking comes from tie-breaking or biases.
- Patchscope readouts show no distinct continuations (effectively empty), consistent with injecting a zero difference vector producing no change.

Conclusion: The finetuning did not instill a new objective/behavior (likely a null finetune or a failed/no-op training run).
